name: Cost meter face
summary: Static gauge: track arc, tone fill sweeping to its level, needle, wall-sized readout.

slots.label: Needle level
slots.tooltip: How far round the arc the fill and needle go: a number from 0 (empty) to 1 (full)

slots.label: Readout
slots.tooltip: The big figure under the gauge, like $4.20

slots.label: Caption
slots.tooltip: The small line under the figure that says what it measures

props.label: Colour
props.tooltip: The colour of the arc's fill and the big figure
